source_assertions.paraphrase: A sign can have more than one interpretation and other signs change the synthesis.
Missing a particular positive indicator does not, on its own, establish the opposite personal quality.
The curriculum requires corroboration by two other movements before including an interpretation.
source_assertions.app_adaptation: At least three genuinely distinct support groups; correlated summaries do not count separately.

source_assertions.locator: Quale tecnica, sign relations and laws
source_assertions.paraphrase: The exposition distinguishes sign roles, rated degree, and supportive or opposing interactions.
The passage gives several alternative handwriting indicators for animation rather than one mandatory sign.
premise_examples: Short t crossbar ending in a point

source_assertions.paraphrase: The passage groups upright, rigid or angular forms among possible indicators of firmness.

states.OBSERVED_ABSENT: The required object/opportunity is present but the specified sign is absent.
states.NOT_ASSESSABLE: Available input cannot establish the sign.
states.NOT_APPLICABLE: This question does not apply to this sample/context.
states.CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE: Evidence disagrees in a way that prevents the proposed answer.
states.NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE: No allowed dynamic candidate passed its checks.

rules: Unanswered -> selected values empty and text null, with reason.
Mixed is genuine regional heterogeneity and must reference its components; it is not a synonym for unknown.
No applicable t is not an absent t-bar.
Source sign absence never automatically activates opposite personality claims.
Confidence is separate, uncalibrated by default.
School intensity scores are never inference confidence or population percentile.

soft_field_definitions.purpose: Describe the overall handwriting pattern without claiming to diagnose its author.
Explain one evidenced relationship between features, including qualifiers.
Explain the selected historical/traditional reading as such, naming its school and limits.
Explain why an alternative reading remains unresolved instead of choosing a flattering answer.
Explain the supplied unusual feature without adding rarity or superiority claims.
Explain graphical similarities and contrasts while retaining both samples' limitations.
Explain comparable graphical change without claiming a change in character or health.
Summarize important unknowns and withheld claims without speculating.

selection_contract.reason: Candidate origin and number selected are independent axes; do not conflate MULTI_SELECT with enum source.

observation_envelope.note: Frequency, intensity, prominence, certainty and population rarity remain distinct; every non-observed numeric quantity may be null.

no_shortcuts: No formula from a curriculum title alone
No unsupported psychological meaning for language-specific marks

release_gates: Review exact morphological definitions and exemplars
Define signed geometry/scales/thresholds for each applicable selector
Acquire original Moretti/Klages/Pulver definitions before activating named school scores
Validate against real annotated writing and content-confound cases
Only then promote a bounded pack from DRAFT

candidate_validation_policy.rule: An allowed candidate ID proves only membership in the approved choice space. A candidate dependent on model-produced graphic observations remains provisional until post-validation checks its prerequisites and evidence type. It cannot be labelled preverified. No pending candidate yields a measured numerical claim.
candidate_validation_policy.single_call_limit: Question order within one multimodal request is not a blinded independent assessment; test salience and content effects.

model_pack_policy: The master catalogue is not one enormous prompt. A compiler supplies only applicable questions and read-only facts, with explicit omission reasons. One bounded request may cover the chosen pack; no call per question.
